title: Using AI in Ecommerce: How It's Transforming Online Shopping
snippet: A simple way to implement this as an ecommerce brand would be to utilize an AI-powered feature that makes product recommendations based on what the customer has in their cart, by suggesting items “people also purchased” that are relevant to that specific customer.
